shared_elements: row of repeated small incised/pecked signs suggesting an inscription
carved marks on a natural rock face
justification: Both surfaces bear a horizontal band of small repeated sign-like marks reading as an inscription cut into a rock face, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise B presents a formally framed, arch-topped composition with registers of standing human figures above ordered columns of text, whereas A shows only crude pecked lines and a large irregular linear form with no figures, framing or register structure.
